---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new feature for AnimeLens
title: "[Feature] Short description of the idea"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 🎯 Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. 
*(Example: "I'm always frustrated when recommendations don't account for anime I've already dropped.")*

## 🚀 Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. 
*(Example: "Add a filter in the settings to exclude 'Dropped' or 'On Hold' anime from the recommendation algorithm.")*

## 🔄 Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
*(Example: "Manually removing dropped anime from my MAL list, but that messes up my actual stats.")*

## 📸 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or mockups about the feature request here. 
*(If you have a visual idea of how it should look in the extension popup or settings, feel free to attach a sketch or screenshot!)*

---
*Thank you for taking the time to suggest an improvement! Your feedback helps shape the future of AnimeLens.* ✨
